title: Handoff Context (v2)
description: Machine-readable metadata for cross-agent handoff. Since v2 this file carries no semantic fields — context-map.md is the only semantic source; this file holds protocol metadata, git state, SHA-256 hashes of the generated views, and migration/conflict diagnostics.

lang.description: Language code used for human-readable content (e.g. zh, en, ja)

views.description: SHA-256 hashes of the generated views (HANDOFF.md, tasks.md, decisions.md) as written; used to detect manual view edits

conflicts.description: Superseded values preserved under Open Questions > Migration conflict
